summary.problem: Training-free video generation with object layout control is challenging.
summary.method: Uses pretrained video diffusion models with coarse layouts to guide spatiotemporal placement and motion.
summary.advance: Improves layout consistency and motion coherence with 20% higher trajectory accuracy and 30% better visual quality.

summary.problem: Existing MLLMs struggle with visual grounding in retinal OCT, often fragmenting lesions into partial predictions.
summary.method: Proposes AggIoU to evaluate if predicted boxes cover annotated regions, and develops RetGrounder with OCT-specific training.
summary.advance: RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9% (43% improvement) across 27 MLLMs, with better recall and accuracy.

summary.problem: Existing streaming methods assume static scenes, leading to pose drift and ghosting over long sequences.
summary.method: Stream4D uses causal KV-Cache Attention to adaptively aggregate temporal motion cues and fuse with depth priors.
summary.advance: Stream4D improves camera pose estimation and static scene reconstruction with 15%+ accuracy gain and reliable dynamic masks.

summary.problem: Existing VLA-RL methods suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to sparse rewards and imbalanced subtask mastery.
summary.method: AtomicRL proposes SAPO for reliable credit assignment and BATE for adaptive exploration using atomic task structures.
summary.advance: AtomicRL achieves 3.6% and 4.0% performance gains on LIBERO-LONG, 9.5% on CALVIN ABC-D, and 21.3% on real-world tasks.

summary.problem: Existing trit-plane codecs treat decoded trits as discrete symbols without exploiting their role as interval constraints on continuous latents.
summary.method: BLI reformulates progressive trit-plane coding as sequential latent inference under shrinking interval constraints using center and width of bounds and hyperprior information.
summary.advance: BLI achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance with 17.78% BD-rate reduction over DPICT and 7.96% over CTC, and a 5.3× fewer parameters model with lower latency.

summary.problem: Existing GVC methods denoise in latent space, leading to irreversible information loss.
summary.method: ResGVC encodes images in a video codec, decomposes distortion into residual segments, and compresses them with a diffusion transformer.
summary.advance: ResGVC achieves 63.7% BD-rate reduction in LPIPS and 83.8% in PSNR compared to prior methods.

summary.problem: Recovering 3D room layouts from fMRI and camera trajectories is challenging due to temporal mismatch between visual changes and blurred fMRI signals.
summary.method: DRAFT extracts a compact layout representation from early visual cortex and fuses it with geometric free space derived from camera motion.
summary.advance: DRAFT achieves a layout r of 0.480 on ten scenes, outperforming camera paths and seven fMRI decoders, and improves all seven decoders without retraining.

summary.problem: Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian, with cues vanishing as objects change or are hidden.
summary.method: WholeBodyMem uses object-guided perceptual memory to retain pre-history of object events before acting on a goal.
summary.advance: WholeBodyMem improves success rates from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and 36.7% to 88.3% on real robot, outperforming memoryless and uniform-memory baselines.

summary.problem: Existing methods segment entire instances as moving when only parts move, leading to inaccurate motion attribution.
summary.method: MoRSe jointly interprets two frames to predict moving-region masks, avoiding instance-level predictions.
summary.advance: MoRSe achieves higher accuracy in distinguishing actual motion from apparent motion, with 1.2% fewer false positives on motionless sequences.

summary.problem: Existing WAMs rely on costly iterative denoising for future video representations, making action prediction sensitive to quality.
summary.method: FRED trains WAMs to predict future video representations from noise using self-distillation and temporal context from ground-truth observations.
summary.advance: FRED achieves 50.0% task success on out-of-domain tasks, outperforming prior work by 30.6% on long-horizon tasks.

summary.problem: Existing FUDA methods require multiple communication rounds, rely on complex aggregation strategies, and struggle with noisy pseudo labels and inconsistent source knowledge.
summary.method: SKD-ETR combines Smoothed Knowledge Distillation (SKD) and Exponential moving average-based Teacher Refinement (ETR) to train a student model on the target domain using smoothed pseudo labels and refine source models via EMA.
summary.advance: SKD-ETR achieves competitive performance on OfficeHome, Office-Caltech, and DomainNet with communication- and computation-efficient training, and improves pseudo-label quality and student generalization without additional communication overhead.

summary.problem: Existing methods fail to account for structural fidelity, cross-dataset robustness, and application-specific error costs in vessel segmentation.
summary.method: Evaluates five segmentation pipelines on multiple datasets using pixel-level agreement, stability, and error analysis.
summary.advance: FSG-Net outperforms others in Macro-F1, IoU, clDice, and Skeleton F1; SA-UNetv2 excels in sensitivity and thin-vessel sensitivity; errors are concentrated near vessel boundaries.

summary.problem: Existing methods lack kinodynamic modeling and safety distances, leading to high yaw rates, collisions, and low navigation success.
summary.method: KinoUAV introduces a hierarchical kinodynamic pipeline and DFD labels for safe trajectory generation and obstacle avoidance.
summary.advance: KinoUAV-Agent achieves highest navigation success rate with lower yaw and collision rates compared to prior work.

summary.problem: World models are trained to predict pixels, but their role is to generate learning signals for policy improvement, not just render visual fidelity.
summary.method: DRILL proposes a bilevel framework that updates world models to maximize policy returns via imagined rollouts, using GRPO and meta-gradient techniques.
summary.advance: DRILL-VWI improves policy performance with 13.1% higher success rate than WMPO and 7.9% over RLVR-World, without additional simulator rollouts.

summary.problem: Existing RS vision models lack systematic data-centric surveys for VLMs.
summary.method: Provides a comprehensive guide for constructing and fine-tuning RS datasets for VLMs.
summary.advance: Offers a structured approach to data construction, fine-tuning, and evaluation for RS VLMs.

summary.problem: Long captions fail due to unsupported specificity in the middle and vague tail language.
summary.method: PAGER uses position-aware rubric representation and GRPO training with separate signals for middle, tail, and content-aware evidence.
summary.advance: PAGER improves position-wise grounding and pairwise caption preference by 15% on detailed-caption benchmarks.

summary.problem: Existing methods struggle to distinguish between modality-specific and interaction-driven predictive utility in multimodal sentiment analysis.
summary.method: I$^2$-KAN proposes a multi-pathway framework with Task-Decoupled Linear-Gated Denoising Bottleneck (TDL-GDB) and structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network fusion to maintain intra-modal and inter-modal information.
summary.advance: I$^2$-KAN achieves 2.3% improvement in F1 score on CMU-MOSI and 1.8% improvement on CH-SIMS v2, demonstrating interaction-driven utility despite low standalone performance.

summary.problem: Existing LoRA methods are tied to specific backbones and fail to generalize across different pretrained models.
summary.method: Proposes LoRA superposition, where LoRAs from different backbones are summed exactly to achieve task performance without modification.
summary.advance: Achieves 30.21% accuracy gain over solo LoRAs and 0.28% below individual LoRAs, outperforming LOMO sums by 6.05%.

summary.problem: Existing methods fail to jointly model trajectory and pose in multi-agent sports with complex social dynamics.
summary.method: A socio-temporal encoder fuses trajectory and pose, using shared factorized attention and per-joint loss reweighting.
summary.advance: Improves pose accuracy by 12.3% on WorldPose and 8.7% on 3DPW, with better generalization in complex scenarios.

summary.problem: Self-supervised Vision Transformers have unreliable patch-level representations for dense prediction.
summary.method: Cross Distillation (CODI) mixes teacher class-token into patch tokens to provide global semantics without changing architecture.
summary.advance: CODI improves dense and image-level performance by 3.2% and 2.5% on benchmarks, respectively.
